## Summary

Describe the change and the user or maintainer need it addresses.

## Change type

- [ ] Documentation or repository foundation
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Security-related change

## Validation

List commands run and their results. If none apply, explain why.

## Security and compatibility

Describe authorization, secrets, data handling, deployment, and compatibility effects. State "Not applicable" with a reason when appropriate.

## Checklist

- [ ] I read the relevant project instructions and documentation.
- [ ] I updated documentation for changed behavior or decisions.
- [ ] I added or updated tests when behavior changed.
- [ ] I did not commit credentials, secrets, or private user data.
- [ ] This PR targets `main` and is ready for review.
